title: Clause of a clause-based document (design criteria, general specifications, reports, procedures, compliance matrices): text, a required value, a matrix row or an automatic data block; the document is generated from its clauses by the technical_documents engine

section.description: section number, e.g. 3 or 3.2 (sections are printed in numeric order)

section_title.description: title of the section (given on its first clause)

parameter.description: parameter or matrix item (printed in a table with value, unit, status, basis)

value_text.description: value as text (ranges, criteria), or the compliance measure of a matrix row

table_head.description: column titles for the table of this section (default: Item, Value, Unit, Status, Basis / remarks)

block.description: automatic content from the records: params:<category,...> | equipment:system=<prefix,...> | equipment:type=<type,...> | guarantees | hmb_summary | aux_loads:<case> | requirements:<ER-id,...> | decisions:<id,...> | permits | tie_ins | progress_rules | doc_types

remarks.description: remarks, or the evidence / document of a matrix row
